workflows_detail.runs_since_2026-09-01: many (dozens), overwhelmingly `build: skipped` (event=issues, no research-exit-head-request label present, or event=issues on an unlabeled/irrelevant issue) or `build: success` before 2026-09-24 with no landing attempt recorded on main — this workflow's `research_result` job only started firing on every trigger from R1 (2026-09-22) onward, per its own header 'if: always() because a FAILED build is itself a result worth landing'
workflows_detail.measured: For all 13 runs (35964326810, 35979604926, 35980322052, 35981819756, 35981853449, 35982396299, 35982418069, 35983166835, 35983442279, 35983731519, 35992152280, 35999563824, 35999566185): actions_list/list_workflow_jobs shows the `build` job status=completed conclusion=skipped on every one; actions_get shows each run's triggering issue was UNRELATED to research (e.g. run 35964326810 = 'system-action: pull-and-deploy — land E31/E32 (#12738)', run 35999566185 = '[trainer-diag-request] E56 health-review ...', run 35979604926 = 'system-action: get-env — read ARBITRATION_FANOUT_ACCOUNTS'); git show of each branch's research/results/_unattributed/<id>.jsonl file confirms read_state=producer_failed on all 13.
workflows_detail.root_cause: ROOT CAUSE, not just an R5 symptom: research-exit-head-build.yml's `on.issues.types: [opened]` trigger has NO label filter — it fires on every issue opened anywhere in the repo (diag-requests, system-actions, manager dispatches, ...). The `build` job's own `if:` correctly requires the `research-exit-head-request` label and skips otherwise, but the downstream `research_result` job ran `if: always()` unconditionally and could not tell 'not applicable (wrong trigger)' from 'ran and genuinely failed' — both read as `needs.build.result != 'success'` to scripts/research/exit_head_result.py, which collapses both into `read_state: producer_failed`. This is the collapsed-states defect class CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL.md names (two states sharing one value, the missing one silent). None of the 13 'lost results' were ever real research; R5 blocking their landing (E57's finding) accidentally kept 13 fabricated placeholder rows off main rather than losing 13 real measurements.
workflows_detail.fix: FIXED in this PR: research-exit-head-build.yml `research_result` job's `if:` now repeats `build`'s own trigger gate (ANDed with always()), so it only runs — landing a real success OR a real producer_failed — when the trigger was actually a research-exit-head request. A mistriggered run now skips both jobs and produces nothing.
workflows_detail.recovery_action: Closed all 13 open 'research result: unattributed' PRs (#12798, #12803, #12805, #12809, #12810, #12813, #12814, #12819, #12821, #12823, #12827, #12835, #12836) as garbage rather than landing them — landing a fabricated producer_failed placeholder would be worse than the current gap. 2 runs (35999566185, 35999563824) and 1 queued run (36000658979) were already in flight on the OLD workflow version when the fix was written and may still open 1-3 more bogus PRs before the fix reaches main; these are cosmetic (same signature, safe to close on sight) and not decision-relevant.
